name: Glass Car Dash
tagline: Live MPH speed and head-nod break reminders
description: Live phone GPS speed with the Silverline gauge, plus a calibrated glasses-motion heuristic that shows a Take a break alert after repeated head nods. Tap to dismiss an alert; double-tap to exit. Requires calibration. This prototype does not confirm drowsiness.
author: Usman Kayani

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Uses your phone’s GPS to show current speed in miles per hour.
